inlines.v: RESTRIC'TION, noun [Latin restrictus.] 1. Limitation; confinement within bounds. This is to have the same restriction as all other recreations. Restriction of words, is the limitation of their signification in a particular manner or degree. 2. Restraint; as restrictions on trade.
